dessin:
A left-to-right chain at mid height (all elements between y 28% and 58%).
Left (x 4-21%, y 28-58%): a pale format sheet filled with a light blue water pattern; inside it a small entity card: a white rectangle with an ink polygon outline and one short ink line under it.
A blue route (#2F6DA8, thick, round caps, arrowhead) from the left sheet to the right, x 22-35%, at y 43%.
Center (x 37-57%, y 28-58%): a pale block with a double outline, containing three small tool pictograms (a compass, a ruler, a pair of scissors) at its top and the same small entity card at its bottom.
A red route (#C4472B, thick, round caps, arrowhead) x 59-71%, at y 43%.
Right (x 73-93%, y 28-58%): a pale format sheet filled with a light green vegetation hatching; inside it the same small entity card, its polygon now filled with the green hatching.

elements.depart: the left format sheet with the blue water pattern (whole sheet)
elements.carte-depart: the small entity card inside the left sheet
elements.lire: the blue route between the left sheet and the center block
elements.bloc: the center block with the tool pictograms (whole block)
elements.carte-bloc: the small entity card inside the center block
elements.contour-bloc: the polygon outline of the entity card inside the center block
elements.attribut-bloc: the short line under the polygon, in the entity card inside the center block
elements.ecrire: the red route between the center block and the right sheet
elements.attendu: the right format sheet with the green hatching (whole sheet)
elements.carte-attendu: the small entity card inside the right sheet
